items.title: Accessibility
items.description: Find options that match your specific accessibility needs — from step-free boarding to roll-in showers.

items.title: Lower-impact travel
items.description: Compare estimated emissions and lower-impact alternatives across rail, electric cabs, and eco-certified stays.

items.title: Practical choices
items.description: Balance cost, time and convenience with transparent fare breakdowns and realistic transfer windows.

items.title: Clear evidence
items.description: See what is verified, reported, community-confirmed or still unverified so you travel with confidence.

editorial.heading: A better way to choose your journey.
editorial.supporting: We compare travel options across accessibility, cost, time, convenience and environmental impact — so you can understand the trade-offs before you choose.
editorial.manifesto: “True luxury in modern India is knowing that every member of your family can move freely, without friction, while leaving the sacred landscapes we visit undisturbed.”
editorial.bullet1Desc: We audit doorway widths, curb ramps, battery wheelchair charging points, and station porters across Indian routes.
editorial.bullet2Desc: Calculated using real Indian grid and transit emissions factors, comparing high-speed electric trains like Vande Bharat against domestic flights.

convergence.title: Where accessibility and sustainability meet.
convergence.description: Often treated as separate priorities, universal accessibility and environmental mindfulness strengthen each other. Shared electric transit, step-free rail hubs, and low-waste architectural stays create more dignified journeys for all travelers.
convergence.leftDesc: Step-free transit · Sensory quiet spaces · Tactile wayfinding · Assistive baggage
convergence.rightDesc: Electrified rail corridors · Zero-single-use stays · Local farm dining · Minimal carbon footprint

business.heading: Make your property easier to discover.

business.bullet1: Free accessibility and carbon baseline audit guide
business.bullet2: Direct visibility to travelers with specific physical & dietary requirements
